LANE A: ORCHESTRATOR COMPOSITION FIXES.

OWNERSHIP: you own ONLY: server/pipeline/orchestrator.py, server/pipeline/interview_transcription.py, tests/test_orchestrator.py, tests/test_keep_timeline.py, tests/test_edit_transcript_prereq.py, tests/test_media_gates_integration.py. Never modify anything else (editorial_plan.py, media_gates.py, video_assembly.py are FROZEN - consume their existing APIs).

FINDINGS (each needs a fix + a proving test):
1. HIGH :1219 - transcript validation demands complete two-track transcription for EVERY episode type; a normal solo (no guest_audio) is marked partial and always halts. Fix: required tracks derive from the episode type/assets (solo requires host only); missing-by-design tracks are not 'partial'.
2. HIGH :1248 - cached transcripts accepted without verifying input identity; replay/rerecord can apply stale cuts to a new timeline. Fix: transcript.json gains source_fingerprint (sha256 of the audio inputs' sizes+mtimes or content hash); _ensure_edit_transcript regenerates when the fingerprint mismatches current assets.
3. HIGH :1497 - interview rendering never invokes validate_angle_segments. Fix: run it on the per-segment outputs before concatenation (media_gates.validate_angle_segments with the planned segments); record in gate_results; halt on failure.
4. HIGH :1595 - the interview transfer time map omits seam-crossfade duration mutations, shifting later anchors. Fix: compose crossfade-induced duration deltas into the time map handed to validate_transfer (every seam's overlap subtracts from edited timeline - reflect it exactly).
5. HIGH :1874 - four-track completeness enforced only when track_manifest exists; a legacy/replayed interview missing guest media falls through to a scalar keep-timeline render WITHOUT angle switching. Fix: for episode_type interview, require the four-track set (or an explicit adopted-artifact receipt) regardless of manifest presence; missing = halt to review, never silent scalar render.
6. HIGH :1953 - production builds an ad hoc marker/must_cut plan instead of calling editorial_plan.build_episode_edit_plan, so retake pairing + unpaired-retake escalation are DEAD in the real chain. Fix: _render_publishable_program (or its caller) must obtain the plan from editorial_plan.build_episode_edit_plan(episode_dir=..., program_source=..., transcript_path=..., duration_s=..., structural=..., editorial_context=...) - marker cuts from find_edit_markers feed IN as structural/must_cut inputs, not as a replacement plan. The unified module is the single plan source for both episode types.
7. HIGH :2061 - recovery adoption accepts any v1 job/token receipt and skips transcript/render/mandatory-cut proof entirely. Fix: adoption requires the adopted final to carry gate receipts (transfer + bumper where applicable) AND a recorded edit-plan receipt proving must_cuts were applied (or an explicit owner-waiver field in the receipt); absent proof = halt to review, not qa-passed.
8. MED :1843 - non-reconnect recordings skip the reconnect gate silently. Fix: record gate=not_applicable with reason in gate_results.
9. MED :2092 - bumper-source validation runs for adopted finals though assembly is skipped. Fix: bumper gate only on paths that assemble; adopted finals record not_applicable.
10. MED :2117 - unexpected rendering/assembly exceptions set error without queue_review. Fix: every halt path queues review in the runcard shape.

TESTS: one per finding minimum, in the owned test files (solo-no-guest advances; fingerprint-mismatch regenerates; angle-segment poison halts; crossfade map correctness; legacy interview missing guest halts; retake cue in transcript produces a must_cut through the REAL chain (monkeypatch only the LLM polish + renderers, not editorial_plan); unproven adoption halts; not_applicable receipts present; exception paths queue review). ALL existing tests green.

HOW TO RUN: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_orchestrator.py tests/test_keep_timeline.py tests/test_edit_transcript_prereq.py tests/test_media_gates_integration.py -q -p no:cacheprovider

OUTPUT CONTRACT: uncommitted changes + ./fix-summary.md ('# Fix Summary','## Summary','## Files Changed','## Verification','## Assumptions', <700 words) mapping each finding number to fix + test.

LANE B: AUTO-ARM + ENDPOINT FIXES.

OWNERSHIP: you own ONLY: server/pipeline/recording_arm.py, scripts/auto-arm-cron.sh, server/app.py, tests/test_recording_arm.py, tests/test_recording_arm_endpoint.py (new; if an existing app-endpoint test file covers /recording/arm, extend THAT instead and name it). Never modify anything else.

FINDINGS:
1. HIGH recording_arm.py:162 - a missing/unparseable booked time is treated as plausible, so a legacy identity match can arm without time proof. Fix: no parseable booked/event time correlation = NOT a candidate via the identity tier; such cases can only arm via an exact episode-id/slug reference; otherwise escalate.
2. HIGH recording_arm.py:645 - the calendar fallback discards recording events without an external guest, so solo recordings never reach the planner. Fix: solo recording events (host-only, title matching the solo episode's topic tokens or an explicit episode reference) are first-class candidates; keep the ambiguity rules.
3. MED recording_arm.py:215 - the prefilter requires guest identity or episode reference before the exact-start solo tier, escalating valid solo events with matching room+exact start. Fix: reorder tiers so exact-start-time + room match is evaluated for solo events before the guest-identity requirement rejects them; ambiguity still escalates.
4. MED scripts/auto-arm-cron.sh:22 - cron falls back to CRON_AUTH_TOKEN but the endpoint (server/config.py:162: RECORDING_ADMIN_TOKEN or CRON_AUTH_TOKEN) - re-read the ACTUAL precedence: config uses RECORDING_ADMIN_TOKEN if set else CRON_AUTH_TOKEN; the reviewer observed a deployment shape where both exist and only RECORDING_ADMIN_TOKEN authenticates. Fix the script to prefer RECORDING_ADMIN_TOKEN when present and document that CRON_AUTH_TOKEN works only when RECORDING_ADMIN_TOKEN is unset. Never echo values.
5. MED server/app.py:1088 - /recording/arm overwrites daily_room_name without verifying room-vs-episode_type compatibility, permanently rebinding future routing on a wrong-room request. Fix: validate the requested room against the episode's type room mapping (read how rooms map to episode types in the codebase - DAILY_AUTO_RECORD_ROOMS/config or recording_state conventions); incompatible = 400 with a clear error, no state change.

TESTS: per finding (time-proof-missing not armed via identity; solo event armed; solo exact-start tier order; script token precedence grep-test; wrong-room 400 + state unchanged via the app test client). ALL existing arm tests green.

HOW TO RUN: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_recording_arm.py tests/test_recording_arm_endpoint.py -q -p no:cacheprovider (adjust the second path if you extended an existing file; run that file).

OUTPUT CONTRACT: uncommitted changes + ./fix-summary.md ('# Fix Summary','## Summary','## Files Changed','## Verification','## Assumptions', <600 words).
